description: Retrospective application for the retention of an existing kitchen extract louvre to the rear yard in association with continued Class E(b) use of the premises.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-ddf0a466-7fff-c960-8533-d9a131219409"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The development, as submitted fails to demonstrate that it adequately mitigates against adverse pollution and odour impacts arising from the use. The development would result in adverse impacts to the amenity and living conditions of neighbouring residential occupiers, particularly those located directly above the premises. As such, the proposal would result in adverse impacts on residential amenity and is contrary to Policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) and LP58 (Improving the Environment - Pollution) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and Policy SI1 (Improving Air Quality) of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-956783b3-7fff-1434-f875-d725fd9923d7"></span></p><div><span id="docs-internal-guid-90614c38-7fff-66ff-b961-851f4dd48afa"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The submitted evidence, including the size of the premises and the floor plan, indicates that the predominant function of the premises would be as a hot food takeaway (Sui generis). In the absence of details relating the use class, function and associated policy requirements on health impact, proximity to schools and concentration of associated uses, the application has failed to demonstrate the development would be acceptable in land use terms. The development as submitted, therefore fails to demonstrate that it would avoid contributing to an over concentration of hot food takeaways in the area along with child obesity levels and wider health inequalities in the area conflict with Policies LP9 (Health and Wellbeing) LP39 (Over-concentration of Uses) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policy E9 (Retail, Markets and Hot Food Takeaways) of the London Plan (2021), paragraph 96(c) of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), and the Planning Practice Guidance.</span></span></div>
